title: storyboard.create_director_plan_version input
description: Appends a director plan version for an episode. It is a draft, and the script version it cites must belong to the same episode.

episodeId.description: The episode this version belongs to.

scriptVersionId.description: The script version this plan was written against.

basedOnVersionId.description: The version this one revises, or empty for the first.

visualRhythm.description: The visual rhythm the episode should have.

cameraLanguage.description: The camera language for the episode.

continuityRules.description: Continuity rules this episode must respect.

changeReason.description: Why this version exists, in one sentence.
